sources.title: Cosmos3-Edge Design — TensorRT Edge-LLM
sources.snippet: The only model-specific pieces on the export side are the Nemotron-H squared-ReLU MLP (Cosmos3ReasonerCausalLM) and the mapping from the checkpoint’s native flat schema to the shared decoder names.

sources.snippet: cosmos3-edge-mlx: Cosmos3-Edge reasoner on Apple Silicon An MLX port of the reasoner in nvidia/Cosmos3-Edge (revision 344d602). It takes text, images and video and answers in text, with optional thinking. The published builds quantize the language model (8-bit or 6-bit, affine, group 64) and keep the SigLIP2 vision tower and projector in bf16.
